title: Vuelta a España Stage 12: Enric Mas Goes Long as ‘Mini-Pogačar’ Omrzel Wins Big
content:
Enric Mas attacked with 11km to go in a brutal climbing stage to distance his GC rivals while Slovenian talent Omrzel wins 'queen stage.'

Read the full article at Vuelta a España Stage 12: Enric Mas Goes Long as ‘Mini-Pogačar’ Omrzel Wins Big on Velo.
author: ahood
